name: Understanding SC 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts (Level A)
snippet: The intent of this success criterion is to reduce accidental activation of keyboard shortcuts . Character key shortcuts work well for many keyboard users. Read more

name: WCAG Character Key Shortcuts Explained
snippet: WCAG 2.1.4 , " Character Key Shortcuts ," focuses on the accessibility concerns related to keyboard shortcuts that use character keys .

name: 2.1.4 Character Key Shortcuts (AA)
snippet: Active only on focus : The keyboard shortcut for a user interface component is only active when that component has focus .

name: F99: Failure of Success Criterion 2.1.4 due to implementing
snippet: The use of a single key keyboard shortcut is not a failure if the shortcut is only active when a particular interface element has focus .
